sections.heading: 1. What to say
lines: ① Give a number: "That's about an 8 out of 10."
② Ask for more, less or another area anytime.
③ Mention injuries, easy bruising or pregnancy.
④ Name any areas you'd rather avoid.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Ever lain there thinking "that's way too much" and said nothing? Momo has.

Harder isn't automatically better. Many people get more out of firm but comfortable pressure that lets muscles relax rather than brace. A simple 0 to 10 scale helps: around 5 to 7 is often a good zone, and if you're holding your breath, it's too much.

You can ask for more, less or a different area at any time. Mention recent injuries, easy bruising or pregnancy. Massage works well alongside active rehab rather than replacing it.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio are always happy to adjust. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
